senses.gloss:
1. वे (cf. √ ऊय्) cl. 1. P. Ā. (Dhātup. xxiii, 37) व॑यति, ˚ते (pf. p. ववौ or उवाय; 2. sg. उवयिथ Gr.; 3. pl. ववुः, ib.; ऊवुः, RV.; ऊयुः, Bhaṭṭ.; Ā. ववे, ऊवे, ऊये Gr.; aor. अवासीत्, अवास्त Gr.; Prec. ऊयात्, वासीष्ट, ib.; fut. वाता, ib.; वास्यति, ˚ते, ib.; वयिष्य॑ति, RV.; inf. ओ॑तुम्, ओ॑तवे, ओ॑तवै॑, ib.; वा॑तवे, AV.),
to weave, interweave, braid, plait (fig. to string or join together artificially, make, compose, e.g. speeches, hymns), RV. &c. &c.;
to make into a cover, into a web or web-like covering, overspread as with a web (said of a cloud-like mass of arrows filling the air), Bhaṭṭ. :
Pass. ऊयते (aor. अवायि) Gr.:
Caus. वाययति, ib. :
Desid. विवासति, ˚ते, ib. :
Intens. वावायते, वावेति, वावाति, ib.
2. वे॑ m. a bird (strong stem of 1. वि॑, q.v.)
